subject: Renewal + Branch air-gapped rollout — term update & ordering

To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + Branch air-gapped rollout — initial ask

Hi Rafael / Monica,

We're coming up on our renewal with Redwood (Aug 14) and would like to consolidate the renewal conversation with an expansion ask. We want to onboard a new branch office site into our Private (on-prem) footprint. Requirements at a high level:

- Completely air-gapped environment for the branch (no outbound internet egress)
- Separate cluster with tenant isolation from main HQ workload
- Two additional GPU nodes (NVIDIA equivalent) for the branch to support peak inference workloads
- 24‑month term for the branch environment to match our hardware procurement cadence

Can you outline what the process and timeline look like? We will need a SOW and network requirements we can hand to our infra team. Also flag any licensing/term implications if we extend to 24 months for the branch.

FYI: cc'ing our ITOps alias and Tom (network lead).

Thanks,
Lisa Nguyen
Head of Platform Reliability
Bayside Health

Subject: Re: Renewal + Branch air-gapped rollout — initial ask

Lisa — thanks for the clear ask. High-level response below and next steps.

Summary: We can support an air-gapped branch with a dedicated on-prem cluster and tenant isolation. The onboarding cadence we typically see for a new air-gapped site is 6–8 weeks from PO + network prep (drives + secure transfer windows), but we can compress to ~4 weeks with an approved SOW and a planned dry-run. Main considerations: image transfer process for air-gapped installs, HSM/KMS options for keys (on-prem HSM recommended), and support model during initial 90 days.

Term: We can align the branch environment with a 24‑month term. Pricing will be pro-rated across the new commit; I'll attach a pricing summary and draft SOW.

Next steps:
- I will share SOW draft + pricing by EOD Tuesday (2027-06-22).
- Vivek — can you confirm approximate installation windows and any additional infra requirements for an air-gapped bootstrap?
- Monica — please prepare renewal paperwork options (24 vs 12‑month) and a bundled discount proposal for the additional clusters.
- Lisa / Tom — please confirm target go-live date and any blackout windows for image transfers.

I'll attach a stub SOW in my next email.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Renewal + Branch air-gapped rollout — initial ask

Rafael — quick technical notes for the SOW / install plan: 

- Air-gap bootstrap: we need an encrypted VM image + signed manifest. Transfer via physically shipped encrypted drive or approved jump-host transfer window. We recommend physically shipped drives for the first install to keep transfer overhead minimal.
- KMS: support for on-prem HSM (YubiHSM / AWS CloudHSM in private link) — will need customer decision before scheduling.
- Network: inbound management from HQ is blocked; we will require a temporary management window on a whitelisted jump-host or a direct VPN peering for initial config (documented in Network-reqs).
- Scaling: two additional GPU worker nodes (prefer A100 or equivalent). We will advise specific SKU once we confirm model quantization profile.

I estimate 4–6 engineer-days onsite-equivalent work (can be remote with shipped drives). If we compress steps and Tom's team provides the network windows, we can hit 3 weeks.

Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions Architect, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: monica.patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Renewal + Branch air-gapped rollout — initial ask

Lisa — Rafael and I discussed commercial options. Two paths we've prepared:

Option A — 24-month branch add-on (recommended):
- 24-month commitment for the branch cluster
- One-time onboarding fee: $25,000 (covers air-gap transfer, image signing, and install support)
- Monthly reservation fee for the two additional GPU nodes: $11,200/month (discounted rate for 24mo)
- 10% volume discount applied to existing HQ commitment when bundled (applies if both PO's sign together)

Option B — 12-month trial + conversion:
- 12-month commitment with higher monthly rate ($14,800/month) and reduced onboarding fee ($15,000)
- Option to convert to 24-month at any time with credit for onboarding fee up to $10k

Attached: draft SOW (SOW-bayside-branch-rollout-v1.pdf) and a pricing line-item CSV. Rafael — happy to sync with finance on the bundled discount structure.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
